testo: Hello, Leo here! Used only part of a salami, pasta pack or bottle? In Consumption & Usage, Partial use records the percentage left. With multipacks you can work on one item and keep the others whole. The slider records your estimate: it does not measure the contents. Eva adds: “Flour on your hands? Cook first! Write down what you use and update the inventory when you have a quiet moment. Memory misses things.” Until you record it, displayed quantities may be out of date.
